summary: TotalEnergies SE filed a Form 6-K on May 6, 2026, publishing proxy materials and a press release in connection with its combined annual and extraordinary shareholders' meeting scheduled for May 29, 2026. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report providing notice of meeting, sample proxy card, and availability of preparatory documents. There is no M&A, tender offer, activist campaign, or other transformative special situation. The meeting agenda covers standard corporate governance resolutions. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic changes are disclosed. This is an ordinary procedural filing, not a special situation.
